purpose: Safe structured diagnostic field and query scope contract. Presence means emitted by the owning context, never inferred from pod names or fabricated for a join.

application_record.time: UTC RFC 3339 with exactly six fractional digits, in both languages.
application_record.level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN or ERROR, upper case in both languages.
application_record.log_type: app, or audit for an event its component's observability.json marks audit.
application_record.scope: service.instance.id is generated once per process; process.pid alone is not globally unique.

service.presence: Required on shared application records; filter environment before grouping.

process.presence: Required on shared application records; process.pid is a supplemental local identifier.

session.presence: Optional, only where trusted Session/workspace context is available. Never assume every process/Auth/TLS record has Session context.

request.presence: Optional. Auth Check records carry the edge-generated request ID as request.id. API, Auth API-key and Event Stream records carry their own request ID as request.id (also the public request-id response header and error request_id) and, once the Auth-signed principal is verified, its request_id claim as edge.request.id. Join Check request.id to backend edge.request.id. Records written before principal verification have no edge.request.id; an incoming X-Request-Id header never supplies it. Correlation is scoped to the observed deployment and request lifetime.

trace.presence: On every record written under a span. A turn is one trace; a developer API request starts its own trace and an incoming traceparent is only a link of it.

external_collection_custody.presence: Attached by the collector, separate from application record fields. Prior-container custody must remain distinguishable; Pod UID is not a Session ID.
external_collection_custody.backend: No remote backend, retention or storage budget is prescribed.

proxy.owner: public edge and routing proxy deployment
proxy.access_logs: Disabled for the public edge, including Git, and for the internal routing sidecars, whose mesh configuration sets no access log file. There is no proxy access-field or Session join contract; proxy failures surface in application records, proxy statistics and vendor startup/control output.
proxy.failure_mapping: Auth Check and native application TLS classify edge failures in application records. Proxy startup/control diagnostics are separate vendor output; never parse raw vendor prose as an application error tuple or publish credentials/request headers/query/body.

excluded_data: raw credentials, API keys, tickets or signed assertions
query strings, bodies, prompts, tool arguments/results or provider response content
raw exceptions, stack traces, SQL or arbitrary SDK error objects

families.emission_policy: Boot-configured threshold defaults Info. Stable owner events and approved scalar fields only. Failure tuple is semantic, independent of severity. Bounded failure windows and fail-open diagnostic sink; healthy high-frequency work quiet.
families.field_presence: Only names backed by the listed owning emitters/builders are mapped here. Shared failure/resource fields may be added by the common diagnostic sink; canonical permission alone does not imply emission.

families.emission_policy: Slow/failing HTTP summary, fast healthy path quiet. RPC normal success/cancel Debug, ordinary rejection Info; classified transport/dependency faults elevated by owning boundary. Public HTTP boundary and auth decision records add edge.request.id from the verified signed principal. URLs/query/body/headers/errors are not log data.
families.field_presence: Only names backed by the listed owning emitters/builders are mapped here. Shared failure/resource fields may be added by the common diagnostic sink; canonical permission alone does not imply emission.

families.emission_policy: Successful Check stages Debug; current non-success Check recorder Warn and bounded by shared failure limiter. request.id is the edge-generated request ID, which the minted principal signs as its request_id claim. families.field_presence: Only names backed by the listed owning emitters/builders are mapped here. Shared failure/resource fields may be added by the common diagnostic sink; canonical permission alone does not imply emission.
